lines: One line, then the next, then the next — I kept drawing them on
Sketching out the next destination, the destination
Treasure island
If I take you with me just as we are
Carefully, carefully, carefully drawing it
With lines that wavered and trembled
Carefully, carefully, carefully drawing it
That's what I'd decided
The next one, and the one after, and the one after that — still not the destination
Searching for the scenery of a dream, the scenery
Treasure island
If I take you with me just as we are
Carefully, carefully, carefully singing it
Even if it wavers and trembles
Carefully, carefully, carefully singing it
That's what I'd decided, but
I'm taking you with me just as we are
Carefully, carefully, carefully I'll draw it
Even if it wavers and trembles
Carefully, carefully, carefully I'll sing it
Even so, I'm taking you with me
With lines that wavered and trembled
I'll draw it
Your song
